src.IFS: ECMWF IFS HRES 0.25 deg (ECMWF open data)
src.AIFS: ECMWF AIFS Single 0.25 deg (ECMWF open data)
src.ICON: DWD ICON global ~13 km native grid (DWD open data), days 1-7
src.ARPEGE: Meteo-France ARPEGE 0.25 deg (Meteo-France open data), days 1-4

note: models/shift = maximum of the model grid-point values inside each district (mm per 24 h); verif = district maximum, meanv = district mean, both for the 03-03 UTC verification windows. codes[i] is the district_code of value index i. shift = the next run's day windows (IC + 12 h).
